Project an eth_signature to its {r, s, v} Object Form

Source: R/signature.R
as_rsv.Rd

Returns the signature as a list(r, s, v) with r/s as minimal 0x-hex (leading zeros stripped, matching eth_utils.to_hex). This is the form venues such as Hyperliquid expect in the request body.

Usage

as_rsv(sig)

Arguments

sig

(eth_signature) a signature from an EthSigner.

Value

(list) a list(r = <0x-hex>, s = <0x-hex>, v = <integer>).

Examples

sig <- eth_signer_random()$sign_message("gm")
as_rsv(sig)
#> $r
#> [1] "0x3892094f655f48e79422e5af3b1cf036b140daecfd600cc5e803c8a7fe095385"
#> 
#> $s
#> [1] "0x420ae7a82a8a1b059f2b7b4756493718b89beb41af65439820ad06b10bf5f084"
#> 
#> $v
#> [1] 27
#>
